pages.title: Where They Generate
pages.text: Naturally generated Iron Cages may appear at Pillager Outposts, in Villages, and in Stronghold End Portal rooms, containing imprisoned wild maids.

pages.title: Structure Rescue Maids
pages.text: Only maids found naturally inside these structure cages count as Rescue Maids. Putting an ordinary maid into a cage later does not grant rescue rewards or make her leave.
